title: fi-cue-controller: measured failure modes of the Freeze Index and an interpretable freezing-of-gait cue controller
description: Analysis plan, amendment, code, frozen configurations, results and embedded Cortex-M4F implementation of a study that measured where the Freeze Index fails on a single lower-back accelerometer and tested an interpretable freezing-of-gait cue controller on unseen data. The plan and code were committed before the development analyses, and the controllers were frozen before any external data were opened. Raw data are not redistributed.
